description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a fragment that contains a LogView and manages log display in an Android application. It sets up views, handles view inflation, and updates scroll position upon text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays log messages in a scrollable, monospace text view.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView components, sets their layout parameters, styling, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy for the fragment, adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text change.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
